import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import xgboost as xgb
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

# Suppress warnings and progress bars
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
submission_path = "./submission/submission.csv"

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)

# Target columns
targets = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]
text_col = "comment_text"
y_train = train_df[targets].values
X_text = train_df[text_col]
id_col = "id"

# Vectorization
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=20000, ngram_range=(1, 2), sublinear_tf=True, min_df=1
)
X_train = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_text)
X_test = vectorizer.transform(test_df[text_col])
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Hold-out validation split (80% Train, 20% Val)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Train XGBoost models for each target
models = []
for i, target in enumerate(targets):
    clf = xgb.XGBClassifier(
        n_estimators=200,
        max_depth=6,
        learning_rate=0.1,
        verbosity=0,
        tree_method="hist",
        random_state=42,
    )
    clf.fit(X_tr, y_tr[:, i])
    models.append(clf)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1] for m in models])
scores = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred, average="macro")
print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC on Validation Set: {scores}")

# Predict on Test Set
y_test_pred = np.column_stack([m.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1] for m in models])

# Create Submission DataFrame
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(y_test_pred, columns=targets)
submission_df.insert(0, "id", test_ids)

# Save to submission folder
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")
plan: I will use TF-IDF vectorization to convert the text into numerical features and train six separate XGBoost classifiers, one for each toxicity label, to handle the multi-label task.
